head: ḫuwart-i / ḫurt-
note: Kloekhorst EDHIL pp. 372-373: ḫurtāi- is explicitly derived from the cursing verb; the proposed Old Prussian swearing cognate identifies *h₂wert-. PIE line marked doubtful.

head: aruna-
note: Kloekhorst EDHIL p. 212: the proposed connection passes through aru- and the elevation of water, with a Sanskrit parallel. PIE line marked doubtful.

head: punušš-zi
note: Kloekhorst EDHIL pp. 681-682: tentative desiderative connection with cognition; LIV² p. 489 explicitly includes punuszi and punussanzi. Retain EDHIL double doubt despite the LIV assignment.

head: šuḫḫa-i / šuḫḫ-
note: Kloekhorst EDHIL pp. 773-774 (compare pp. 396-398): the pouring paradigm is connected with išḫuwai- through laryngeal metathesis, *sh₂u- / *suh₂-. Retain the question mark on the PIE line.
